name: Criticizing
overview: Scripture teaches that criticizing others should be tempered by humility and self-awareness, recognizing the measure of faith God has given to each person, as Romans 12:3 instructs believers to think soberly of themselves. Ephesians 4:29 emphasizes the importance of speaking only words that build up and minister grace to others, avoiding corrupt or harmful speech. Additionally, James 5:16 encourages confessing faults and praying for one another, highlighting a spirit of mutual support and restoration rather than judgment.
